answer: Because the sable pair is tracked in the beacon ledger, the mesa audit records which half was completed and the cut is applied at settlement. Two answers per epoch doubles the authoring work per alias, so running 166 identities means 166 pairs of texts plus a separate attestation for each, which is exactly the labour a farm is trying to avoid. Full reward requires answering a second challenge with different words, and skipping it cuts the payout by 43%. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
